en.headline: Local ice-cream brand TEEMTONEfai opens first permanent shop in Sheung Wan
en.dek: After a decade of pop-ups, the Hong Kong maker known for inventive flavours has settled at Upper Lascar Row with nine new Chinese-inspired scoops and soft-opening promotions through the end of August.
body: Hong Kong ice-cream maker TEEMTONEfai has opened its first permanent flagship store in Sheung Wan, marking the brand’s tenth anniversary after years of temporary pop-ups and collaborations.

The shop at ground floor, 19 Upper Lascar Row, began soft opening on 21 August. Founder Thomas Fung has introduced nine new flavours that draw on Chinese tea, spices and local ingredients, including white peach oolong, sea salt green Sichuan pepper, red date and purple rice, watercress honey and young coconut, and ginger tofu pudding.

During the soft-opening period, the first 50 paying customers each day on 21 and 22 August received a free special-edition ice-cream spoon while stocks lasted. From 21 to 31 August, customers buying ice-cream vouchers or a 10-cup box set can take advantage of a buy-10-get-2-free offer. The shop is open daily from noon to 7 p.m.

zh.headline: 本地雪糕品牌TEEMTONEfai上環開首間實體店
zh.dek: 成立十年後，以創意口味聞名的香港雪糕品牌終於在上環摩羅上街落腳，推出九款中式靈感新口味，試業優惠至八月底。
body: 香港雪糕品牌TEEMTONEfai（甜筒暉）於上環開設首間永久旗艦店，慶祝品牌成立十周年。過去十年，品牌以期間限定店及聯乘合作聞名。
新店位於上環摩羅上街19號地下，8月21日開始試業。創辦人Thomas Fung推出九款全新口味，揉合中式茗茶、香料及本地食材，包括荔枝碧螺春、海鹽青花椒、紅棗紫米、野菜蜜椰青及薑汁豆腐花等。
試業期間，8月21及22日每天首50位光顧客人可獲贈特別版雪糕小匙；8月21日至31日購買雪糕券或10杯裝禮盒可享買10送2優惠。店舖每日中午12時至下午7時營業。
